title: End-of-day close checklist (Day Reporting)
summary: Manager close-out: reconcile Day Reporting, void reasons, and next-open resets.

steps.title: Review Day Reporting before rollover
steps.instructions: Terminal close cash drawers, then in Toast Web open Day Reporting: variance per drawer, tips out of sync, and open checks must be zero before the day rolls.

steps.title: Sweep void reasons
steps.instructions: Filter the day’s voids; every saved-item void should carry a reason code — chase blanks with shift leads.

steps.title: Confirm run-scoped 86s are cleared for tomorrow
steps.instructions: Any item still 86’d for restock should either return to menu at open or get a proper availability plan for the day.
